```{r}
source("./R/data-prep.R")


criteria_dat |> 
  filter(analyte == "bmi") |> 
  mutate(bmi_t = if_else(value > 30, 1, 0)) |> 
  summarise(.by = c(treat, bmi_t), 
            n = n() , 
            m = mean(value)) |> 
  
  print()


```
